text.en: Tim has a small white cat. The cat likes to sleep on the red mat.
text.zh: 蒂姆有一只流行的小白猫。猫喜欢睡在红色的垫子上。

questions.q: What color is Tim's cat?
Where does the cat sleep?

questions.q: What color is the ball?
Who does Sam roll the ball to?
What does Sam do with the ball?

text.en: The sun is very bright today. Lily drinks cold water to stay cool.

text.zh: 一只小绿青蛙坐在石头上。它啪嗒一声跳进了池塘里。

questions.q: Where does the frog sit?

questions.q: What fruit does Mia eat?

questions.q: What color is Tom's bike?

questions.q: What does the monkey hang from?

questions.q: Where does the star shine?

questions.q: What fruit does Oliver slice?

text.zh: 格蕾丝画了一片蓝色的海洋和艘绿色的大船。她用亮丽的画笔给海浪上色。

questions.q: What is the wind like?

questions.q: What juice does Leo pour?

desc.en: Learn when to use 'a' and 'an'.
desc.zh: 学习何时使用 'a' 和 'an'。

rule.en: Use 'a' before consonant sounds and 'an' before vowel sounds (a, e, i, o, u).
rule.zh: 辅音发音前用 'a'，元音发音（a, e, i, o, u）前用 'an'。

questions.q: I have ___ cat.
She sees ___ elephant.
He eats ___ red apple.
This is ___ orange book.
We saw ___ big dog.
I want ___ ice cream cone.
Look at ___ umbrella over there.

desc.en: Learn to use I, You, He, She, It, We, and They.
desc.zh: 学习使用 I, You, He, She, It, We, They。

rule.en: Use He for a boy, She for a girl, It for a thing/animal, and They for more than one person.
rule.zh: 男用 He，女用 She，物体/动物用 It，复数用 They。

questions.q: Tom is my friend. ___ is seven years old.

The sun is bright. ___ is in the sky.

rule.zh: 拿着或靠近物体时用 'this'，指向远处物体时用 'that'。

desc.en: Show who owns something.
desc.zh: 表示物品所属关系。

rule.en: Use my (belonging to me), your (belonging to you), his (belonging to a boy), and her (belonging to a girl).
rule.zh: my（我的），your（你的），his（他的），her（她的）。

desc.en: Add -s for He, She, and It.
desc.zh: 主语为 He, She, It 时动词加 -s。

rule.en: Use 'like' with I/You/We/They, and 'likes' with He/She/It.
rule.zh: I/You/We/They 用 like，He/She/It 用 likes。

rule.en: Use 'have' with I/You/We/They, and 'has' with He/She/It.
rule.zh: I/You/We/They 用 have，He/She/It 用 has。

questions.q: I ___ a red ball.

desc.en: Adjectives describe nouns and go before them.
desc.zh: 形容词修饰名词，放在名词前面。

rule.en: Place size and color adjectives before the noun (a big red house).
rule.zh: 将大小和颜色形容词放在名词前（如 a big red house）。

questions.q: I see a ___ balloon.
The elephant is a ___ animal.
She bought a ___ dress.
He has a ___ dog.
Look at the ___ sky.
They live in a ___ house.
We ate a ___ apple.

desc.en: Action verbs show what a subject does.
desc.zh: 动作动词说明主语做出的行为。

rule.en: Action verbs describe physical or mental actions (run, jump, sleep, read).
rule.zh: 动作动词描述身体或心理动作（如 run, jump, sleep, read）。

questions.q: Birds ___ in the sky.
Fish ___ in the water.
Rabbits ___ high.
Children ___ games in the park.
I ___ books every night.
Cats ___ on soft cushions.
We ___ water when we are thirsty.

desc.en: Learn prepositions of place.
desc.zh: 学习表示位置的介词。

rule.en: Use 'in' for inside, 'on' for on top of a surface, and 'under' for below.
rule.zh: 'in' 表示在……里面，'on' 表示在表面上，'under' 表示在下面。

questions.q: The book is ___ the table.
The apple is ___ the basket.
The cat is sleeping ___ the bed.
Pencils are ___ the pencil case.
The picture hangs ___ the wall.
The dog is resting ___ the shade of the tree.
Put your shoes ___ the cabinet.

desc.en: Ask questions with What, Who, and Where.
desc.zh: 用 What, Who, Where 提问。

rule.en: Use 'What' for things, 'Who' for people, and 'Where' for places.
rule.zh: 'What' 询问事物，'Who' 询问人物，'Where' 询问地点。

questions.q: ___ is your name?
___ is that boy?
___ is my hat?
___ are you eating?
___ is your English teacher?
___ do you live?
___ is in your schoolbag?

desc.en: Express ability or inability.
desc.zh: 表达能力或不能。

rule.en: Use 'can' for things you are able to do, and 'cannot' / 'can't' for things you are unable to do.
rule.zh: 'can' 表示能够，'cannot / can't' 表示不能。

questions.q: Birds ___ fly in the sky.

I ___ speak English.

desc.en: Start with a capital letter and end with . or ?
desc.zh: 首字母大写，句末加句号或问号。

rule.en: Every sentence starts with a capital letter. Statements end with a period (.) and questions end with a question mark (?).
rule.zh: 每句话首字母大写。陈述句加句号（.），问句加问号（?）。

questions.q: ___ dog is very big.

desc.en: Give simple instructions and orders.
desc.zh: 给出简短指令和要求。

rule.en: Imperative sentences begin with a base verb to tell someone what to do.
rule.zh: 祈使句以动词原形开头，指示他人做出动作。

___ run in the hallway.

writing.en: What is your favorite animal? Why do you like it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的动物是什么？你为什么喜欢它？

writing.en: What color do you like best? What things are that color?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢什么颜色？哪些东西是这个颜色的？

writing.en: What do you like to eat for breakfast? Who makes it for you?
writing.zh: 你早餐喜欢吃什么？谁为你做早餐？

writing.en: Who is your best friend? What games do you play together?
writing.zh: 谁是你最好的朋友？你们一起玩什么游戏？

writing.en: What is your favorite toy? Why is it special to you?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的玩具是什么？它为什么对你很特别？

writing.en: Do you like rainy days or sunny days? What do you do on those days?
writing.zh: 你喜欢雨天还是晴天？在那些日子里你会做什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing to do at the park? Who goes with you?
writing.zh: 你在公园里最喜欢做什么？谁和你一起去？

writing.en: Tell me about your family. What do you love about them?
writing.zh: 告诉我关于你家人的事情。你喜欢他们的什么？

writing.en: What do you like to do on the weekend? How does it make you feel?
writing.zh: 你周末喜欢做什么？这让你感觉怎么样？

writing.en: What is your favorite fruit? How does it taste?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的水果是什么？它尝起来味道怎么样？

writing.en: What is your favorite ice cream flavor? When do you eat it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢什么口味的冰淇淋？你什么时候吃它？

writing.en: What clothes do you like to wear? What color are they?
writing.zh: 你喜欢穿什么衣服？它们是什么颜色的？

writing.en: What is your favorite book? What happens in the story?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的书是什么？故事里发生了什么？

writing.en: What pet would you like to have? What would you name it?
writing.zh: 你想养什么宠物？你会给它取什么名字？

writing.en: What game do you love to play? How do you play it?
writing.zh: 你喜欢玩什么游戏？你怎么玩它？

writing.en: What is your favorite school subject? Why do you like it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢学校的什么科目？你为什么喜欢它？

writing.en: What do you do before you go to bed? Who reads a story with you?
writing.zh: 你在睡觉前做什么？谁和你一起读故事？

writing.en: What is your favorite drink on a hot day? How does it make you feel?
writing.zh: 大热天你最喜欢的饮料是什么？它让你感觉怎么样？

writing.en: What do you like to draw? What colors do you use?
writing.zh: 你喜欢画什么？你使用什么颜色？

writing.en: What is your favorite holiday? What do you do on that day?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的节日是什么？你在那一天做什么？

writing.en: What song do you love to sing? Where do you sing it?
writing.zh: 你喜欢唱什么歌？你在哪里唱它？

writing.en: What is your favorite snack after school? Who gives it to you?
writing.zh: 放学后你最喜欢的零食是什么？谁给你的？

writing.en: Do you like to swim in the pool or sea? Why do you enjoy it?
writing.zh: 你喜欢在泳池里还是大海里游泳？你为什么喜欢它？

writing.en: What is your favorite room in your house? What do you do inside?
writing.zh: 家里你最喜欢哪个房间？你在里面做什么？

writing.en: What season do you like best? What do you wear in that season?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢什么季节？你在那个季节穿什么？

writing.en: What do you like to do on a birthday? What cake do you want?
writing.zh: 过生日你喜欢做什么？想要什么蛋糕？

writing.en: What is your favorite cartoon character? What can they do?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的卡通角色是谁？他们能做什么？

writing.en: What bird or insect do you like? Where do you see it?
writing.zh: 你喜欢什么鸟或者昆虫？你在哪里看到它？

writing.en: What do you eat for dinner? Who sits with you at the table?
writing.zh: 你晚餐吃什么？谁和你一起坐在桌旁？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing in your bedroom? Why do you like it?
writing.zh: 房间里你最喜欢的东西是什么？你为什么喜欢它？

writing.en: What sport do you like to play? Who do you play with?
writing.zh: 你喜欢做什么运动？你和谁一起做运动？

writing.en: Do you like to build with blocks or Lego? What do you build?
writing.zh: 你喜欢用积木还是乐高搭东西？你搭什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite place to visit? What do you see there?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢去游览的地方是什么？你在那里看到什么？

writing.en: What do you do when it snows? How do you keep warm?
writing.zh: 下雪的时候你会做什么？你怎么保暖？

writing.en: What makes you smile or laugh? Why is it funny?
writing.zh: 什么事情让你微笑或大笑？它为什么好笑？

writing.en: What is your favorite storybook picture? What is in the picture?
writing.zh: 故事书里你最喜欢哪张插图？画里有什么？

writing.en: What treat do you get on weekends? How does it taste?
writing.zh: 你周末能吃到什么好吃的？味道怎么样？

writing.en: What kind of shoes do you wear to run? What color are they?
writing.zh: 你跑步穿什么鞋？它们是什么颜色的？

writing.en: What is your favorite flower or plant? Where does it grow?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的花或植物是什么？它生长在哪里？

writing.en: What animal sounds can you make? Which sound is your favorite?
writing.zh: 你能发出什么动物的叫声？哪个声音是你最喜欢的？

writing.en: What do you carry in your school bag? What color is your bag?
writing.zh: 你书包里装了什么？你的书包是什么颜色的？

writing.en: What is your favorite vegetable? How do you eat it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的蔬菜是什么？你怎么吃它？

writing.en: What craft do you like to make with paper? What colors do you cut?
writing.zh: 你喜欢用纸做什么手工？你剪下什么颜色的纸？

writing.en: What ride do you like at the playground? How fast does it go?
writing.zh: 在游乐场你最喜欢玩什么游乐设施？它转得有多快？

writing.en: What do you like to do on a bus or car ride? Who sits next to you?
writing.zh: 坐公交车或乘车时你喜欢做什么？谁坐在你旁边？

writing.en: What is your favorite bedtime stuffed animal? What color is it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的睡前毛绒玩具是什么？它是什么颜色的？

writing.en: What funny face can you make? Who laughs when you make it?
writing.zh: 你能做出什么样的鬼脸？当你做鬼脸时谁会大笑？

writing.en: What do you like to do at recess? Who plays with you?
writing.zh: 课间休息你喜欢做什么？谁和你一起玩？

writing.en: What is your favorite sweet treat? When do you get to eat it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的甜食是什么？你什么时候能吃到它？

writing.en: What animal would you like to see at the zoo? Why is it cool?
writing.zh: 在动物园你想看什么动物？它为什么很酷？

writing.en: What do you help your parents do at home? How does it help them?
writing.zh: 你在家里帮父母做什么？这怎么帮到他们？

writing.en: What is your favorite sea creature? What does it look like?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的海洋生物是什么？它长什么样？

writing.en: What hat or cap do you wear outside? What color is it?
writing.zh: 你在户外戴什么帽子？它是什么颜色的？

writing.en: What do you like to eat at a party? What games do you play?
writing.zh: 派对上你喜欢吃什么？你玩什么游戏？

writing.en: What sound in nature do you like? Why is it peaceful?
writing.zh: 你喜欢大自然里的什么声音？为什么它很安静宁和？

writing.en: What is your favorite song to dance to? Who dances with you?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢跳舞配什么歌？谁和你一起跳舞？

writing.en: What do you like to do on a hot summer day? How do you stay cool?
writing.zh: 在炎热的夏天你喜欢做什么？你怎么解暑？

writing.en: What animal would you like to fly like? Where would you fly?
writing.zh: 你想像什么动物一样飞翔？你会飞去哪里？

writing.en: What is your favorite warm drink in winter? How does it taste?
writing.zh: 冬天你最喜欢的热饮是什么？味道怎么样？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing about going to school? Who is your favorite classmate?
writing.zh: 关于去上学你最喜欢的事情是什么？谁是你最喜欢的同班同学？

text.en: Class Three students planted a small garden behind their school. They grew red tomatoes and green peas there. Everyone watered the vegetables after lunch.
text.zh: 三年级的学生在学校后面种了一个小菜园。他们在那里种了红番茄和青豌豆。每个人午饭后都给蔬菜浇水。

questions.q: Where is the school garden located?
What vegetables did they grow?
When did students water the garden?

text.en: Leo went to his uncle's farm with cows in the spring holiday. He fed the young cows warm milk from bottles. He watched fresh milk go into big metal buckets.
text.zh: 春假时，利奥去了叔叔的奶牛场。他用奶瓶里的温牛奶喂小牛。他看着新鲜牛奶装进大金属桶里。

questions.q: What farm does Leo visit?
What does Leo use to feed the calves?
Where was fresh milk gathered?

text.en: Sam and his father made a wooden birdhouse on Saturday afternoon. They painted the outside light blue and put on a small round roof. Then they hung it high on a thick tree branch.
text.zh: 星期六下午，山姆和爸爸做了一个木鸟屋。他们把外面刷成浅蓝色，还装上一个小圆屋顶。然后他们把它高高挂在粗树枝上。

questions.q: When did Sam build the birdhouse?
What color did they paint the walls?
Where did they hang the birdhouse?
options: High up on an oak branch

text.en: Honeybees fly across green fields to find sweet flower food. They do a special dance to tell other bees where to go. Their home stays full of honey when they work together.
text.zh: 蜜蜂飞过绿色田野去找甜甜的花蜜。它们跳特别的舞，告诉别的蜜蜂该去哪里。它们一起干活，蜂房里就有很多蜂蜜。

questions.q: What do honeybees travel across fields to find?
What do bees use to communicate with others?
What stays full in their hive?

text.en: Maya played by the sea on a hot summer afternoon. She put smooth, colorful shells in a yellow bucket. Before she left, she made a big sandcastle with a red flag.
text.zh: 炎热的夏日下午，玛雅在海边玩。她把光滑、彩色的贝壳放进黄色桶里。离开前，她做了一个插着红旗的大沙堡。

questions.q: Where did Maya spend her afternoon?
What did Maya collect?
What did she build before leaving?

text.en: Ben joined a new swimming class at the town center. His teacher showed him how to kick his legs and float on his back. In the third week, Ben swam safely across the shallow pool.
text.zh: 本在镇活动中心参加了初学游泳班。老师教他踢腿和仰面漂浮。到了第三周，本能安全地游过浅水池。

questions.q: Where did Ben join the swimming class?
What did his coach teach him first?
When could Ben swim across the pool?

text.en: Dolphins are smart animals that live together in warm sea water. They use clicks and whistles to talk under the water. Sometimes they jump high to play near boats.
text.zh: 海豚是聪明的动物，它们一起生活在温暖的海水里。它们用咔哒声和口哨声在水下说话。有时它们在船边高高跳起玩耍。

questions.q: What kind of animals are dolphins?
What do dolphins use to talk underwater?
What do dolphins do near passing boats?

text.en: Emma goes to the library near her home every Friday afternoon. She borrows storybooks about magic castles and old rainforest animals. The quiet place helps her read without noise.
text.zh: 艾玛每个星期五下午都去家附近的图书馆。她借关于魔法城堡和古老雨林动物的故事书。安静的地方让她能不受噪声打扰地阅读。

questions.q: When does Emma visit the library?
What topics are her storybooks about?
What does the quiet library help Emma do?

text.en: Grandma and Lucy made a warm apple pie for dessert. They peeled red apples and mixed them with cinnamon. The house smelled very good while the pie baked in the oven.
text.zh: 奶奶和露西做了一个热苹果派当甜点。她们削了红苹果，还拌上肉桂粉。苹果派在烤箱里烤时，屋里闻起来很香。

questions.q: What dessert did Grandma and Lucy make?
What spice did they mix with apples?
What did the house smell like while baking?

text.en: Oliver put his small telescope on the grass behind his house. At midnight, he looked at holes on the bright moon. He also saw shooting stars flash across the sky.
text.zh: 奥利弗把小望远镜放在房子后面的草地上。半夜，他看明亮月亮上的坑。他还看见流星闪过天空。

questions.q: Where did Oliver set up his telescope?
What did Oliver observe on the moon?
What flashed across the sky?

text.en: Tom washed three sweet oranges and cut them in half. He squeezed the juice into a clean glass with ice. He drank the cold juice after his long bike ride.
text.zh: 汤姆洗了三个甜橙子，并把它们切成两半。他把果汁挤进装有冰的干净玻璃杯里。骑了很久的自行车后，他喝了冰果汁。

questions.q: What number of oranges did Tom slice?
What did Tom put in the glass cup?
When did Tom drink the juice?

text.en: Cool autumn wind blew colorful leaves off old trees in the park. Children used red and yellow leaves to make art. Then they jumped into a soft pile of leaves.
text.zh: 凉凉的秋风把彩色叶子从公园的老树上吹下来。孩子们用红叶和黄叶做手工。然后，他们跳进软软的一堆叶子里。

questions.q: What blew the leaves off the trees?
What did children make with the leaves?
What did children jump into?

text.en: Mia found a tiny gray kitten under a wooden bench. She took it home and gave it a small dish of milk. The happy kitten made a soft sound and slept in her lap.
text.zh: 米娅在一张木长凳下发现一只小灰猫。她把小猫带回家，给它一小碟牛奶。开心的小猫轻轻地叫着，在她腿上睡着了。

questions.q: Where did Mia find the kitten?
What did Mia give the kitten?
Where did the kitten fall asleep?

text.en: David and his dad put up a green tent by a quiet river. At dusk, they cooked sweet marshmallows over a small fire. At night, they listened to crickets in the forest.
text.zh: 大卫和爸爸在安静的河边搭起绿色帐篷。黄昏时，他们在小火上烤甜棉花糖。晚上，他们听森林里的蟋蟀叫。

questions.q: Where did David and his dad pitch the tent?
What food did they roast over the campfire?
What sound did they listen to at night?

text.en: Giant pandas live in cool bamboo forests in the mountains. They eat green bamboo for most of the day. Their thick black-and-white fur keeps them warm in winter.
text.zh: 大熊猫生活在山上的凉爽竹林里。它们一天大部分时间都在吃绿竹子。黑白相间的厚毛让它们冬天保持温暖。

questions.q: Where do giant pandas live?
What do pandas spend most of their day eating?
What does their thick fur do for them?

text.en: The yellow city bus goes down Main Street every fifteen minutes. Passengers tap plastic cards and sit by the clean windows. The driver tells everyone about the next stops.
text.zh: 黄色城市公交车每十五分钟经过主街。乘客刷塑料卡，然后坐在干净的窗边。司机告诉大家下一站。

questions.q: When does the city bus travel?
What do passengers use to pay for the ride?
What does the driver announce clearly?

text.en: Heavy white snow covered the whole yard on a cold January morning. Toby and his sister made a tall snowman with an orange carrot. They put a warm red scarf around the snowman's neck.
text.zh: 一月一个寒冷的早晨，厚厚的白雪盖住了整个院子。托比和姐姐用一根橙色胡萝卜做了一个高雪人。他们把暖和的红围巾围在雪人脖子上。

questions.q: What covered the yard in January?
What did they use for the snowman's nose?
Where did they wrap the red wool scarf?

text.en: The school bakery sells warm rolls every morning before the first class. Students wait quietly to buy honey bread and oat cookies. The money buys new storybooks for the school library.
text.zh: 学校面包店每天早上第一节课前卖热面包卷。学生们安静排队买蜂蜜面包和燕麦饼干。卖的钱用来给学校图书馆买新故事书。

questions.q: When does the school bakery sell rolls?
What items do students buy?
What does the school buy with the raised money?

text.en: Class Four went to the city aquarium to learn about sea animals. They watched colorful fish swim in clear blue tanks. The guide told them how sea turtles keep their eggs safe on sandy beaches.
text.zh: 四年级去了城市水族馆，学习海洋动物。他们看彩色鱼在清澈的蓝色水箱里游。导游告诉他们海龟怎样在沙滩上保护自己的蛋。

questions.q: What did Class Four go to the aquarium to learn about?
What swam through the blue water tanks?
What did the guide explain about sea turtles?

text.en: Sarah and her family put a red checked blanket on the grass. They ate turkey sandwiches, sweet grapes, and drank cold apple juice under a tree. After eating, they played frisbee near the pond.
text.zh: 莎拉和家人在草地上铺了一条红格子毯子。他们在树下吃火鸡三明治和甜葡萄，还喝冰苹果汁。吃完后，他们在池塘边玩飞盘。

questions.q: Where did Sarah's family lay their blanket?
options: On the grass under a tree

questions.q: What food and drinks did they enjoy?
What game did they play after eating?

text.en: Alex made a small toy robot with colorful blocks that snap together. The robot can roll on the wooden floor and flash yellow lights. Alex presses a red button to make it turn in circles.
text.zh: 亚历克斯用彩色拼插积木做了一个小玩具机器人。机器人能在木地板上滚动，还会闪黄灯。亚历克斯按红按钮，让它转圈。

questions.q: What did Alex use to build the robot?
Where can the robot roll?
What happens when Alex presses the red button?

text.en: A tall white lighthouse stands on a rocky cliff by the sea. Its strong light helps ships stay away from sharp rocks at night. The keeper checks the big light bulb every evening at sunset.
text.zh: 一座高高的白灯塔立在海边的岩石悬崖上。夜里，它的强光帮助船远离尖石头。看守人每天傍晚日落时检查大灯泡。

questions.q: Where does the white lighthouse stand?
What does the lighthouse beam do for ships?
When does the keeper check the light bulb?

text.en: Soft rain fell on the dry green grass all morning. Flowers opened their colorful petals to catch the fresh rain. Soon, a bright rainbow appeared in the clear blue sky.
text.zh: 整个上午，细雨落在干干的绿草上。花儿打开彩色花瓣接新鲜雨水。很快，明亮的彩虹出现在清蓝的天空中。

questions.q: What is the rain like?
What do flowers open their petals to catch?
What appeared across the sky after rain?

text.en: Grandpa made a small wooden toy train for Jack's eighth birthday. It has three dark red cars joined by tiny metal hooks. Jack rolls the train on a smooth track in his bedroom.
text.zh: 爷爷为杰克八岁生日做了一列小木玩具火车。它有三节深红色车厢，用小金属钩连在一起。杰克在卧室的平滑轨道上推火车。

questions.q: Who carved the wooden toy train?
What number of cars does the train have?
Where does Jack roll the train?
options: Along a smooth track in room

text.en: Mom made round golden pancakes for Sunday breakfast. She put sweet yellow honey and fresh strawberry slices on top. Everyone ate two pancakes before going to the park.
text.zh: 妈妈做了圆圆的金黄色煎饼当星期天早餐。她在上面放甜黄蜂蜜和新鲜草莓片。大家去公园前都吃了两张煎饼。

questions.q: When did Mom cook golden pancakes?
What did Mom add on top of pancakes?
Where did the family go after breakfast?

text.en: The fire station is in the middle of our small town. Three firefighters wear yellow suits and red helmets every day. When the alarm rings, they drive a big fire truck to help people. They work to keep the town safe.
text.zh: 消防站在我们小镇的中间。三名消防员每天穿黄色衣服和红色头盔。警报响起时，他们开大消防车去帮助大家。他们让小镇更安全。

questions.q: Where is the local fire station located?
options: In the middle of our town

questions.q: What color suits do the firefighters wear?
What vehicle do they drive when alarm sounds?
What do firefighters do?

text.en: Lucas got a bright red bike for his eighth birthday. His older brother helped him on the park path. At first, Lucas felt scared and unsteady as he held the handlebars. After much practice, he could ride by himself.
text.zh: 卢卡斯八岁生日时得到一辆亮红色自行车。哥哥在公园小路上帮助他。开始时，他握着车把，觉得害怕又不稳。练习很多次后，他能自己骑车了。

questions.q: What gift did Lucas receive for his birthday?
Who guided Lucas while learning?
What is Lucas like at first?
What happened after much practice?

text.en: Students met in the gym for the yearly science show. Ella made a volcano with paper and brown clay. When she mixed vinegar and baking soda, red foam came out. Everyone cheered, and her project got a blue prize ribbon.
text.zh: 学生们在体育馆参加每年的科学展。艾拉用纸和棕色泥做了一座火山。她把醋和小苏打混在一起时，红泡沫冒了出来。大家都欢呼，她的作品得了蓝色奖带。

questions.q: Where was the science project show held?
What model did Ella build?
What caused red foam to bubble out?
What did Ella win?

text.en: Sea turtles spend almost all their lives in the ocean. At night, mother turtles crawl onto sandy beaches to lay round eggs. They cover the nest with sand to keep the eggs safe from other animals. Weeks later, baby turtles come out and run to the sea.
text.zh: 海龟几乎一辈子都生活在海里。晚上，海龟妈妈爬上沙滩下圆圆的蛋。它们用沙子盖住窝，保护蛋不被别的动物吃掉。几周后，小海龟出来，跑向大海。

questions.q: Where do sea turtles spend almost their entire lives?
When do female turtles lay their eggs?
What do turtles protect with sand?
What do baby turtles do after hatching?

text.en: Class Three took a yellow school bus to the zoo. They saw two giant pandas eating bamboo leaves in the shade. Later, they watched a trainer feed fish to seals in a pool. Before going home, everyone bought animal bookmarks at the gift shop.
text.zh: 三年级的学生坐黄色校车去了动物园。他们看见两只大熊猫在阴凉处吃竹叶。后来，他们看训练员在池子里喂海豹吃鱼。回家前，大家在礼品店买了动物书签。

questions.q: What did Class Three use to travel to the zoo?
What were giant pandas eating?
What animal was fed fish by the trainer?
What souvenir did students buy before leaving?

text.en: Autumn is the time to pick apples in local apple farms. Farmers pick many crisp red apples from tall trees every day. They put the apples neatly in strong wooden boxes. Soon, trucks take the boxes to markets in the nearby city.
text.zh: 秋天是当地苹果园摘苹果的时候。农民每天从高树上摘很多脆红苹果。他们把苹果整齐地放进结实的木箱。很快，卡车把箱子运到附近城市的市场。

questions.q: What season is the apple harvest?
What do farmers use to store the apples?
What are the apples like?
Where do trucks take the crates?

text.en: Mom mixed flour, warm water, and yeast in a big bowl. She worked the soft dough on a wooden board until it was smooth. After it grew bigger in a warm place, she baked it in the oven. The bread had a crisp outside and a soft middle.
text.zh: 妈妈把面粉、温水和酵母放在大碗里混合。她在木板上揉软面团，直到它变光滑。面团在暖和的地方变大后，她把它放进烤箱烤。面包外面脆，里面软。

questions.q: What ingredients did Mom mix together?
Where did Mom knead the dough?
What did Mom do before baking?
options: Let dough rise in warm spot

questions.q: What was the baked bread like?

text.en: Little penguins live in groups by the cold coast of Antarctica. They swim very fast in icy water to catch small fish. Their thick, oily feathers keep water out and keep heat in. At night, they stand close together to stay warm in the cold wind.
text.zh: 小企鹅成群生活在南极洲寒冷的海边。它们在冰水里游得很快，去抓小鱼。厚厚的油羽毛不让水进去，也把热留在身体里。晚上，它们挤在一起，在冷风中保持温暖。

questions.q: Where do little penguins live?
What do penguins swim fast to catch?
What do oily feathers do for penguins?
options: Keep water out and trap heat

questions.q: What do penguins do at night against cold winds?

text.en: Jack and his family put up a green tent by a mountain stream. In the afternoon, they walked on trails among pine trees. At sunset, they cooked fresh soup over a warm fire. After dark, they pointed at bright stars in the sky.
text.zh: 杰克和家人在山间小溪边搭起绿色帐篷。下午，他们在松树中间的小路上走路。日落时，他们在暖火上煮新鲜汤。天黑后，他们指着天上的亮星星。

questions.q: Where did Jack's family pitch their tent?
What activity did they do during the afternoon?
What food did they prepare over the campfire?
What do they look at after dark?

text.en: A honeybee home has many worker bees and one queen. Worker bees get sweet flower food from fields. They bring it back to the hive and make honey. Bees also help plants grow by carrying pollen from flower to flower.
text.zh: 一个蜂巢里有很多工蜂和一只蜂王。工蜂从田野的花朵上采甜花蜜。它们把花蜜带回蜂巢做成蜂蜜。蜜蜂还把花粉从一朵花带到另一朵花，帮助植物生长。

questions.q: What number of queens are in a honeybee colony?
What do worker bees collect from flowers?
What do worker bees make back at the hive?
What do honeybees do for plants?
options: Carrying pollen from flower to flower

text.en: Our city park is a green place in the town center. Families come on weekends to eat under tall maple trees. Children play on swings, slides, and climbing frames. A walking path goes around a quiet pond with ducks.
text.zh: 我们的城市公园是镇中心的一片绿色地方。家庭周末来高高的枫树下吃东西。孩子们玩秋千、滑梯和攀爬架。一条步道绕着有鸭子的安静池塘。

questions.q: Where is the city park located?
What kind of trees shade the picnic area?
What playground equipment do children use?
What animal lives in the park pond?

text.en: Big ships stop at the ocean harbor every morning. Giant cranes lift heavy metal boxes off the ships. Harbor workers guide trucks that carry the goods to nearby storehouses. Seagulls fly over the blue water looking for fish pieces.
text.zh: 每天早上，大船停在海港。巨大的吊车把重金属箱从船上吊下来。港口工人指挥卡车把货物运到附近仓库。海鸥在蓝水上飞，寻找小鱼块。

questions.q: What ships dock at the harbor every morning?
What machinery lifts heavy metal containers?
Who guides the trucks?
What birds fly above searching for fish scraps?

text.en: An artist puts soft gray clay on a turning wheel. She uses wet fingers to make the clay into a smooth bowl. After it dries, the bowl is baked in a very hot oven. At last, she paints colorful patterns on the bowl.
text.zh: 一位艺术家把软灰泥放在转盘上。她用湿手指把泥做成光滑的碗。碗变干后，放进很热的窑里烤。最后，她在碗上画彩色图案。

questions.q: What material does the artist place on the wheel?
What does the artist use to shape the clay?
Where is the bowl baked after drying?
What is the final step in making pottery?

text.en: Our solar system has the sun and eight planets that go around it. Earth is the third planet from the sun and has oceans of water. Mars is called the red planet because red iron dust covers its ground. Scientists send space robots to study faraway planets.
text.zh: 我们的太阳系有太阳和八颗绕着它转的行星。地球是离太阳第三近的行星，有很多海水。火星因为地面有红色铁尘，所以叫红色星球。科学家派太空机器人研究远处的行星。

questions.q: What number of planets orbit the sun in our solar system?
What position is Earth from the sun?
What makes Mars look red?
options: Rusty iron dust on its surface

questions.q: What do scientists send to explore distant planets?

text.en: The city library has many books in neat rows on shelves. Children come after school to do homework and read storybooks. Library workers help students find books for class work. Reading clubs meet every Saturday morning to share favorite stories.
text.zh: 城市图书馆的书整齐地排在书架上。孩子们放学后到这里做作业和读故事书。图书管理员帮助学生找上课要用的书。读书小组每个星期六早上见面，分享喜欢的故事。

questions.q: Where does the library keep its books?
When do children visit to do homework?
Who guides students to find reference books?
When do special reading clubs meet?

text.en: Deserts are dry places with very little rain all year. Camels can walk a long way there without water. Their wide, flat feet stop them from sinking in soft sand. Many desert plants keep water in thick stems to live in the hot sun.
text.zh: 沙漠是一年里很少下雨的干燥地方。骆驼在那里可以走很远，不喝水。它们宽平的脚不让它们陷进软沙里。很多沙漠植物把水存进粗茎里，在热太阳下生长。

questions.q: What are desert regions like?
What can camels do without drinking water?
What do camels’ wide feet do?
Where do desert plants store water?
What weather condition do desert plants survive?

text.en: Doctor James Naismith made basketball in December 1891. He put two peach baskets on a gym balcony for the first goals. Players threw a soccer ball into the baskets to get points. Today, basketball is a popular game played by many people around the world.
text.zh: 詹姆斯·奈史密斯医生在1891年12月发明了篮球。他把两个桃子篮放在体育馆阳台上，当作最早的球篮。球员把足球扔进篮子得分。今天，篮球是世界上很多人玩的热门运动。

questions.q: Who invented basketball?
When was basketball invented?
What did Naismith use for the first goals?
What ball was used in the first basketball games?
What is basketball like today?

text.en: Paper was first made in ancient China about two thousand years ago. An official named Cai Lun mixed tree bark, hemp, old rags, and water. He mashed the mix and pressed it flat to make sheets. Paper let people write books and keep records more easily.
text.zh: 大约两千年前，纸最早在中国古代做出来。一位叫蔡伦的官员把树皮、麻、旧布和水混在一起。他把这些东西捣碎，压成平纸。纸让人们更容易写书和记录事情。

questions.q: Where was paper first invented?
Who is credited with inventing paper?
What ingredients were combined to make paper pulp?
options: Tree bark, hemp, old rags, water

questions.q: What did Cai Lun do to make paper sheets?
options: Mashed into pulp and pressed flat

questions.q: What did paper help people do?
options: Allowed writing books and recording history

text.en: Coral reefs are colorful homes under the sea made by tiny coral animals. Sea turtles, clownfish, and crabs live there. The bright coral gives small fish a place to hide and food to eat. Keeping coral reefs safe helps ocean animals live well.
text.zh: 珊瑚礁是小珊瑚动物在海底做成的彩色家园。海龟、小丑鱼和螃蟹住在那里。明亮的珊瑚给小鱼藏身的地方和食物。保护珊瑚礁能让海洋动物好好生活。

questions.q: What creatures build coral reefs?
What animals live in coral reef ecosystems?
What do bright corals provide for small fish?
What do coral reefs help keep safe?
What are coral reef ecosystems like?

text.en: Honeybees help flowers, fruit trees, and vegetables grow. One hive can have more than fifty thousand bees. Worker bees fly far each day to get pollen and sweet flower food. Without bees, many crops and fruits could not grow.
text.zh: 蜜蜂帮助花、果树和蔬菜生长。一个蜂巢里可以有五万多只蜜蜂。工蜂每天飞很远去采花粉和甜花蜜。没有蜜蜂，很多庄稼和水果就不能生长。

questions.q: What do honeybees help?
What number of bees can a single hive contain?
What do worker bees collect every day?
What is the answer in the passage?
What would happen without honeybees?
options: Many crops and fruits could not grow

text.en: Wind is clean energy that will not run out. Big wind turbines stand on windy hills to catch moving air. When the blades turn, machines make electricity. Clean wind power can run homes and schools without making the air dirty.
text.zh: 风是一种用不完的清洁能源。大风力发电机立在有风的山上，接住流动的空气。叶片转动时，机器发电。清洁风电能给家和学校供电，不让空气变脏。

questions.q: What kind of energy is wind?
Where do giant wind turbines stand?
What happens when turbine blades spin?
What can clean wind energy power?
What benefit does wind energy offer?

text.en: James Watt made the steam engine better long ago. It used hot steam from boiling water to move heavy parts and turn iron wheels. Steam engines ran early trains and factory machines. This new machine helped towns and factories grow fast.
text.zh: 很久以前，詹姆斯·瓦特改进了蒸汽机。它用开水的热蒸汽推动重部件，带动铁轮子转。蒸汽机带动早期火车和工厂机器。这个新机器让城镇和工厂很快发展。

questions.q: Who improved the steam engine?
When was the steam engine improved?
What did the steam engine use to move pistons?
What machinery did steam engines power?
What effect did the steam engine have?

text.en: Solar panels catch sunlight and turn it into electricity. Dark silicon cells on the panels take in sun rays on sunny days. A machine changes the electricity so home tools can use it. Solar power can save money and help keep Earth clean.
text.zh: 太阳能板接住阳光，把它变成电。板上的深色硅电池在晴天吸收太阳光。一台机器改变电流，让家里的电器能用。太阳能可以省钱，也帮助地球保持干净。

questions.q: What do solar panels capture?
What material absorbs sun rays on panels?
What do inverters do to electrical current?
When do silicon cells absorb sun rays?
What twin benefits does solar energy provide?
options: Reduces electricity bills and protects Earth

text.en: The rainforest canopy is the top layer made by tall tree branches. Most rainforest animals live high in this leafy layer. Toucans, monkeys, and tree frogs find fruit and hiding places there. Sunlight is bright at the top, but the forest floor is dark.
text.zh: 雨林树冠是高树枝形成的顶层。大部分雨林动物住在这片高高的树叶里。巨嘴鸟、猴子和树蛙在那里找水果和藏身处。上面阳光很亮，森林地面却很暗。

questions.q: What forms the rainforest canopy?
options: Dense upper layer of tall tree branches

questions.q: What percentage of rainforest wildlife lives in the canopy?
What animals live high up in the canopy?
What do animals find in thick canopy leaves?
What is the forest floor like?

text.en: Ancient Egyptians built pyramids as tombs for kings. Skilled workers moved many heavy limestone blocks to make them. The Great Pyramid of Giza was the tallest building made by people for many years. Today, visitors come from all over the world to see these stone buildings.
text.zh: 古埃及人建金字塔，给国王当坟墓。熟练工人搬来很多重石灰石块建造它们。吉萨大金字塔很多年都是人造的最高建筑。今天，世界各地的游客来参观这些石头建筑。

questions.q: What were ancient pyramids built for?
What stone blocks were used to build pyramids?
What pyramid was the tallest man-made structure for centuries?
Who constructed these massive pyramid structures?
What do visitors admire today?

text.en: The deep ocean is cold, dark, and far below the sea surface. Sunlight cannot reach there, so sea animals live in darkness. Many deep-sea fish have glowing parts to catch food. Anglerfish and giant squid can live with the strong water pressure. Scientists use robot submarines to study this underwater world.
text.zh: 深海又冷又黑，在海面很深的下面。阳光到不了那里，所以海洋动物住在黑暗中。许多深海鱼有会发光的部分，用来找食物。琵琶鱼和大鱿鱼能在很强的水压下生活。科学家用机器人潜水艇研究这个水下世界。

questions.q: Where is the deep ocean?
Where does sunlight not reach?
What do many deep-sea fish have?
What animals can live with strong water pressure?
What do scientists use under the sea?
What do scientists study there?

text.en: The Great Wall of China is a famous old building. It goes for thousands of miles over mountains and northern deserts. Ancient soldiers built watchtowers on the wall to guard the country and send smoke signals. Many travelers visit places such as Badaling to walk on the old stones. The wall is still a proud sign of Chinese history and building skill.
text.zh: 中国长城是世界上很有名的古建筑。它越过高山和北方沙漠，延伸几千英里。古代士兵在长城上修了烽火台，保护国家、传递烟火信号。很多游客去八达岭等地方走在古老的石头上。长城今天仍是中国历史和建造本领的骄傲象征。

questions.q: What is the Great Wall of China like?
What land does the wall cross?
What do watchtowers help soldiers do?
options: Guard borders and send signal smoke

questions.q: What restored wall section is mentioned for visitors?
What does the Great Wall symbolize today?
Who visits the Great Wall today?

text.en: Bi Sheng made movable-type printing in China in the eleventh century. He carved Chinese characters on small clay blocks and baked them hard. Later, Johannes Gutenberg made a metal printing press in Germany. Books could then be made faster and more cheaply than writing by hand. This helped more people read and learn around the world.
text.zh: 毕昇在11世纪的中国发明了活字印刷。他把汉字刻在小泥块上，再把它们烧硬。后来，约翰内斯·古腾堡在德国做了金属印刷机。书可以比手写得更快、更便宜。这帮助世界上更多人读书和学习。

questions.q: Who invented movable type printing in China?
What material did Bi Sheng carve characters on?
Who created a metal printing press in Germany?
What did printing help people do?
What impact did printing have on the world?
When was movable type invented in China?

text.en: Green plants make their food in a process called photosynthesis. Plant roots take water and minerals from the soil. Green leaves take a gas called carbon dioxide from the air and catch sunlight. Sunlight changes the water and gas into sugar and oxygen. This gives people and animals oxygen to breathe.
text.zh: 绿色植物用一个叫光合作用的过程做自己的食物。植物的根从泥土里吸收水和矿物质。绿叶从空气里吸收一种叫二氧化碳的气体，还接住阳光。阳光把水和气体变成糖和氧气。这给人和动物呼吸用的氧气。

questions.q: What do green plants make?
What do plant roots absorb from soil?
What gas do green leaves collect from air?
What does sunlight energy convert water and gas into?
What does the passage say about photosynthesis?
What absorbs sunlight in plants?

text.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun. Scientists send robot cars, such as Perseverance, to study its dry, rocky ground. These robots take clear photos and drill rocks to check them. They look for old signs of water life in dry lakebeds. Future space trips hope to send people to Mars.
text.zh: 火星是离太阳第四近的行星。科学家派“毅力号”等机器人车研究它干燥、多石的地面。这些机器人拍清楚的照片，还钻开石头检查。它们在干涸湖床找过去有水中生命的痕迹。未来的太空旅行希望把人送到火星。

questions.q: What position is Mars from the sun?
What robot car is named in the text?
What do robotic rovers do on Mars?
options: Take photos and drill rock samples

questions.q: Where do rovers search for ancient signs of water life?
What is the future goal for Mars space missions?
options: Send human astronauts to land on Mars

questions.q: What is the surface of Mars like?

text.en: Clean energy comes from natural things that can be used again and again. Solar panels use sunlight to make electricity. Wind turbines use moving air, and dams use flowing water to make electricity. Homes and cities can use this clean power. Clean energy makes less dirty air and helps the world stay safe.
text.zh: 清洁能源来自可以一直再用的自然事物。太阳能板用阳光发电。风力发电机用流动的空气，水坝用流动的水发电。家和城市都能用这种清洁电。清洁能源让脏空气变少，帮助保护世界。

questions.q: What is clean energy?
options: Energy that does not run out

questions.q: What do solar panels use to make electricity?
What do wind turbines use to make electricity?
What do hydroelectric dams produce renewable electricity?
What benefit does clean energy offer global climate?
What do dams use to make electricity?

text.en: Honeybees help wild plants and farm crops grow. One worker bee can visit more than one thousand flowers in a day to get nectar. Pollen sticks to its fuzzy body and moves from flower to flower. This helps plants make seeds, nuts, and fruit. Protecting bees helps us have enough food.
text.zh: 蜜蜂帮助野生植物和农田作物生长。一只工蜂一天可以去一千多朵花上采花蜜。花粉粘在它毛茸茸的身体上，被带到别的花上。这帮助植物结种子、坚果和水果。保护蜜蜂能帮助我们有足够的食物。

questions.q: What do honeybees help grow?
What number of flowers can a single worker bee visit in one day?
Where do pollen grains stick on the bee's body?
What does pollination allow plants to produce?
What do honeybees help people have?
What food do bees gather for energy?

text.en: People dreamed of flying like birds for thousands of years. In 1903, Orville and Wilbur Wright made the first airplane with a motor. Their plane flew for twelve seconds over the sandy hills of Kitty Hawk. Today, jet planes carry hundreds of people over oceans in a few hours. Modern planes connect people and places around the world.
text.zh: 几千年来，人们梦想像鸟一样飞翔。1903年，奥维尔和威尔伯·莱特做了第一架有发动机的飞机。他们的飞机在基蒂霍克的沙丘上飞了12秒。今天，喷气式飞机几个小时就能载几百人飞过大洋。现代飞机连接了世界各地的人和地方。

questions.q: Who built the first powered airplane in 1903?
What was the time of their first motorized flight?
Where did the Wright brothers make their historic flight?
What do modern jet airplanes carry across oceans?
What does modern aviation connect?
When was the first powered airplane built?

text.en: Some living things make light in dark places. In the ocean, changes inside animals can make blue or green light. Tiny plankton glow when waves hit the shore at night. Deep-sea jellyfish flash light to scare hungry animals away. Scientists study this light to make new medical tools and colors.
text.zh: 有些活的东西会在黑暗处发光。在海洋里，动物身体里的变化能发出蓝光或绿光。晚上，海浪打到岸边时，小浮游生物会发亮。深海水母闪光，吓走饥饿的动物。科学家研究这种光，做新的医疗工具和颜色。

questions.q: What can some living things make?
What colors can ocean animals make?
When do tiny plankton glow?
options: When waves hit the shore at night

questions.q: What do jellyfish use light flashes to do?
What do scientists make with this light?
What do scientists make with the light?

text.en: Great inventions change daily life for people. Thomas Edison made a useful electric light bulb in 1879. Alexander Graham Bell made the first telephone to send voices on wires. Modern inventors make smart computers and clean-energy tools to solve problems. Curiosity and hard work help people make new things.
text.zh: 伟大的发明会改变人们的日常生活。托马斯·爱迪生在1879年做出实用的电灯泡。亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔做了第一部电话，让声音在线里传送。现在的发明家做智能电脑和清洁能源工具来解决问题。好奇心和努力帮助人们做出新东西。

questions.q: Who invented the practical electric light bulb in 1879?
What did Alexander Graham Bell create?
What do modern inventors design to solve global problems?
options: Smart computers and clean energy systems

questions.q: What virtues inspire new discoveries that change the world?
What do great inventions do for people’s lives?
options: Shape history and improve daily life

questions.q: When was the electric light bulb invented?

desc.en: Actions happening right now.
desc.zh: 正在发生的动作。

rule.en: Use am/is/are + verb-ing to talk about actions happening right now.
rule.zh: 使用 am/is/are + 动词-ing 表示正在发生的动作。

questions.q: Look! The dog is ___ fast.
She is ___ a storybook now.
They are ___ soccer in the yard.
Listen! The birds are ___ in the tree.
I am ___ my homework right now.
He is ___ delicious soup in the kitchen.
The children are ___ happy songs together.

desc.en: Past actions ending in -ed.
desc.zh: 过去发生的规则动作 (-ed)。

rule.en: Add '-ed' to regular verbs to talk about completed past events.
rule.zh: 规则动词末尾加 '-ed' 表示过去完成的事。

questions.q: Yesterday, I ___ in the park.
She ___ her grandmother last Sunday.
They ___ basketball after school yesterday.
He ___ to music for an hour last night.
We ___ our hands before lunch.
The rain ___ two hours ago.
Mom ___ a delicious cake for my birthday.

title.zh: 一般过去时：不规则动词

desc.en: Common irregular past verbs (went, ate, saw).
desc.zh: 常见不规则过去式动词。

rule.en: Irregular verbs change form in the past tense (go -> went, eat -> ate, see -> saw, buy -> bought).
rule.zh: 不规则动词过去式改变形式（如 go->went, eat->ate, see->saw）。

questions.q: Yesterday, we ___ to the zoo.
He ___ an apple for breakfast this morning.
I ___ a beautiful bird in the tree yesterday.
She ___ a new book last week.
They ___ milk before going to bed.
We ___ a great film last night.
The boy ___ his keys yesterday afternoon.

title.zh: 过去进行时：Was 与 Were

desc.en: Was and Were for actions in progress in the past.
desc.zh: 使用 Was / Were 表示过去正在进行的动作。

rule.en: Use 'was' with singular subjects (I, he, she, it) and 'were' with plural subjects (we, you, they).
rule.zh: 单数主语（I/He/She/It）用 was，复数主语（We/You/They）用 were。

questions.q: The chickens ___ running across the farmyard.
I ___ writing a letter at 8 PM yesterday.
The boys ___ playing football in the rain.
She ___ sleeping when the telephone rang.
We ___ studying together all evening.
The cat ___ chasing a mouse under the table.
They ___ waiting for the bus at 7 AM.

desc.en: Compare two people, animals, or things.
desc.zh: 比较两个人或事物。

rule.en: Add '-er' to short adjectives (taller, faster) and use 'more' before long adjectives (more beautiful).
rule.zh: 短形容词加 '-er'，多音节形容词前加 'more'。

questions.q: An elephant is ___ than a dog.
Tom is ___ than his younger brother.
A sports car is ___ than a bicycle.
This flower is ___ than that one.
My house is ___ than yours.
English is ___ than math for me.
Today is ___ than yesterday.

desc.en: Compare three or more things.
desc.zh: 三个或以上事物的最高级比较。

rule.en: Use 'the -est' for short adjectives (the tallest) and 'the most' for long adjectives (the most famous).
rule.zh: 短形容词前加 the，词尾加 -est；长形容词前加 the most。

questions.q: Jupiter is the ___ planet in our solar system.
Giraffes are the ___ land animals.
Cheetahs are the ___ animals on land.
This is the ___ story in the book.
Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.
July is usually the ___ month of the year here.
She is the ___ girl in our class.

desc.en: Use me, him, her, us, and them after verbs.
desc.zh: 动词后使用 me, him, her, us, them。

rule.en: Object pronouns (me, him, her, it, us, them) receive the action of a verb.
rule.zh: 宾格代词（me, him, her, us, them）充当动词的宾语。

questions.q: Please help ___ with this heavy box.
John is nice. I like ___ very much.
Anna is friendly. We invited ___ to our party.
The teacher gave ___ a great star.
Look at those birds! Can you see ___?
My brother called ___ on the phone.
We saw Tom and Ben and spoke to ___.

desc.en: Mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs.
desc.zh: 学习 mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs。

rule.en: Possessive pronouns stand alone without a noun (This bag is mine).
rule.zh: 名词性物主代词单独使用，不带名词（如 This bag is mine）。

questions.q: This pen belongs to me. It is ___.
That hat belongs to Mary. It is ___.
Is this coat yours or ___?
We bought this house. It is ___.
They park their car here. That red car is ___.
I have my umbrella. Where is ___?
The blue notebook on the desk is ___.

desc.en: Always, usually, sometimes, never.
desc.zh: 学习频度副词的用法与位置。

rule.en: Place frequency adverbs before main verbs, but after 'be' verbs.
rule.zh: 频度副词放在行为动词前，be 动词后。

questions.q: He ___ eats breakfast at 7 AM.
She is ___ cheerful in the morning.
I ___ walk to school on sunny days.
They ___ play football on weekends.
My grandfather ___ drinks coffee late at night.
We are ___ late for our classes.
She ___ reads bedtime stories to her sister.

title.en: Prepositions of Time: At, On, In

desc.en: Use at for times, on for days, in for months/years.
desc.zh: At 接时刻，On 接具体日期，In 接月份/年份。

rule.en: Use 'at' for clock times (at 8 AM), 'on' for days/dates (on Monday), and 'in' for months/years (in July).
rule.zh: 'at' 接具体点钟，'on' 接具体星期和日期，'in' 接月份、年份和季节。

questions.q: Our class starts ___ 8:00 AM.
We do not go to school ___ Sunday.
My birthday is ___ October.
The concert is ___ May 15th.
It snows a lot here ___ winter.
He goes to sleep ___ night.
We visited Beijing ___ 2024.

desc.en: Many, much, some, and any.
desc.zh: Many, much, some, any 的辨析使用。

rule.en: Use 'many' with countable plural nouns and 'much' with uncountable nouns. Use 'some' in positive statements.
rule.zh: 'many' 修饰复数可数名词，'much' 修饰不可数名词，肯定句用 'some'。

questions.q: How ___ apples are on the table?
How ___ water is in the glass?
I have ___ milk in my cup.
Do you have ___ questions?
There are ___ books on the shelf.
We do not have ___ sugar left.
How ___ money do you need?

title.en: Future Tense: Will vs Going To
title.zh: 将来时：Will 与 Going to

desc.en: Express future plans and predictions.
desc.zh: 表达将来计划与预测。

rule.en: Use 'will' for spontaneous decisions/promises and 'be going to' for planned actions.
rule.zh: 'will' 用于临时决定/承诺，'be going to' 用于打算好的计划。

questions.q: Tomorrow, I ___ visit my grandparents.
She is ___ to buy a new bicycle next week.
Don't worry, I ___ help you with that.
Look at the dark clouds! It is ___ to rain.
We ___ travel to Shanghai this weekend.
They are ___ to watch a movie tonight.
I think it ___ be sunny tomorrow.

title.en: Conjunctions: And, But, Or, So, Because
title.zh: 连词：And, But, Or, So, Because

desc.en: Join clauses and sentences together.
desc.zh: 连接分句与句子。

rule.en: Use 'and' for addition, 'but' for contrast, 'or' for choices, 'because' for reasons, and 'so' for results.
rule.zh: 'and' 递进，'but' 转折，'or' 选择，'because' 因果，'so' 结果。

questions.q: I like apples ___ I like bananas.
He ran fast, ___ he missed the bus.
I stayed at home ___ it was raining.
Would you like tea ___ coffee?
She studied hard, ___ she passed the test.
He was tired, ___ he went to bed early.
We stayed indoors ___ the weather was cold.

desc.en: Must for strong rules, should for advice.
desc.zh: Must 表示必须，Should 表示建议。

rule.en: Use 'must' for strong obligation/rules and 'should' for friendly advice.
rule.zh: 'must' 表示强烈的规则/义务，'should' 表示建议。

questions.q: You ___ stop when the traffic light is red.
You ___ eat more vegetables to stay healthy.
Students ___ be quiet in the library.
It is raining outside. You ___ take an umbrella.
Drivers ___ obey the speed limit.
You ___ brush your teeth twice a day.
We ___ protect environment for our future.

desc.en: Myself, yourself, himself, herself.
desc.zh: 学习 myself, yourself, himself, herself。

rule.en: Use reflexive pronouns when the subject and object are the same person.
rule.zh: 当主语和宾语为同一人时使用反身代词。

questions.q: He taught ___ how to play guitar.
She looked at ___ in the mirror.
I made this cake all by ___.
Be careful! Don't hurt ___ with the knife.
The cat cleaned ___ with its tongue.
We enjoyed ___ at the party.
They prepared the meal by ___.

writing.en: If you could have any superpower for one day, what would it be? How would you use it to help others?
writing.zh: 如果你能拥有一天的超能力，你想要什么？你会如何使用它来帮助别人？

writing.en: Imagine you found a secret door in your bedroom. Where does it lead to and what do you see?
writing.zh: 想象你在卧室里发现了一扇秘密门。它通向哪里，你在那里看到了什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite hobby? Why do you enjoy doing it in your free time?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的爱好是什么？为什么你喜欢在空闲时间做这件事？

writing.en: If you could invent a helpful robot, what would it look like? What chores would it do for you?
writing.zh: 如果你能发明一个有用的机器人，它长什么样？它会帮你做哪些家务？

writing.en: Describe your dream treehouse. What fun games and rooms would you put inside?
writing.zh: 描述一下你梦想中的树屋。你会在里面放哪些有趣的游戏和房间？

writing.en: If you were a famous explorer, where would you go? What mysterious things would you discover?
writing.zh: 如果你是一位著名的探险家，你想去哪里？你会发现什么神秘的东西？

writing.en: Write a story about a pet that can talk. What funny things would your pet say to you?
writing.zh: 写一个关于会说话的宠物的故事。你的宠物会对你说什么有趣的话？

writing.en: Imagine you could travel into outer space. Which planet would you visit and who would you take with you?
writing.zh: 想象你可以去外太空旅行。你想去哪个星球，你会带谁一起去？

writing.en: Who is your best friend? What are three fun things you love to do together?
writing.zh: 谁是你最好的朋友？你们最喜欢一起做的三件有趣的事情是什么？

writing.en: If it rained your favorite food instead of water, what food would it be? How would you collect it?
writing.zh: 如果天上下的不是雨而是你最喜欢的食物，那会是什么？你会怎么把它们收集起来？

writing.en: What is the best gift you ever received? Why is it special to you?
writing.zh: 你收到的最好的礼物是什么？它为什么对你很特别？

writing.en: If you could talk to any ocean animal, which one would it be? What would you ask them?
writing.zh: 如果你能和任何海洋动物说话，你想和哪种说话？你会问他们什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite family tradition? What makes it so fun for everyone?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的家庭传统是什么？是什么让大家觉得这么有趣？

writing.en: Imagine you spent a day living in a cartoon world. What cartoon would it be and what would you do?
writing.zh: 想象你在卡通世界里生活了一天。那会是哪个卡通，你会做什么？

writing.en: If you had a magic carpet, where would you fly first? What would you see from the sky?
writing.zh: 如果你有一块魔毯，你会先飞去哪里？你从天上会看到什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite game to play with your family? Why is it so exciting?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢和家人玩什么游戏？为什么它这么令人兴奋？

writing.en: If you could change one school rule, what rule would you change? What would the new rule be?
writing.zh: 如果你能改变一条学校规则，你会改变哪一条？新的规则会是什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite meal that your parents cook? Why do you like it so much?
writing.zh: 你父母做的饭菜里你最喜欢哪一道？为什么你这么喜欢它？

writing.en: If you found a magic lamp with three wishes, what would your first wish be? Why?
writing.zh: 如果你发现了一个可以满足三个愿望的神灯，你的第一个愿望会是什么？为什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite movie or TV show? Who is your favorite character in it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的电影或电视节目是什么？里面你最喜欢的角色是谁？

writing.en: If you could build a house out of candy, what sweets would you use for the walls and roof?
writing.zh: 如果你能用糖果建一座房子，你会用什么甜食来做墙壁和屋顶？

writing.en: What is your favorite outdoor activity in spring? How does it make you feel?
writing.zh: 春天你最喜欢的户外活动是什么？它让你感觉怎么样？

writing.en: If you had a pet dragon, what would you name it? Where would you take your dragon to play?
writing.zh: 如果你有一只宠物龙，你会给它取什么名字？你会带你的龙去哪里玩？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing about your school classroom? What makes your classroom special?
writing.zh: 关于你的学校教室，你最喜欢什么？是什么让你的教室很特别？

writing.en: If you could grow any plant in a magic garden, what would grow on the branches?
writing.zh: 如果你能在魔法花园里种植任何植物，树枝上会长出什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite sport or physical activity? What do you like most about it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的体育活动是什么？你最喜欢它的什么？

writing.en: If you could travel back in time, what historical place or event would you visit?
writing.zh: 如果你能穿越回过去，你会去游览哪个历史地方或事件？

writing.en: What is your favorite dessert to eat at a party? Why is it your top choice?
writing.zh: 在派对上你最喜欢吃什么甜点？为什么它是你的首选？

writing.en: Imagine you could talk to birds. What news would they bring you from the sky?
writing.zh: 想象你能和鸟儿说话。它们会从天上为你带来什么消息？

writing.en: What is your favorite place to relax when you are tired? What do you do there?
writing.zh: 当你累的时候你最喜欢在哪里放松？你在那里做什么？

writing.en: If you could design a new playground slide, what shape and color would it be?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一个新的游乐场滑梯，它会是什么形状和颜色？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing to do on a rainy afternoon indoors?
writing.zh: 下雨的下午在室内你最喜欢做什么？

writing.en: If you could turn invisible for one hour, where would you hide and what would you do?
writing.zh: 如果你能隐形一小时，你会藏在哪里，会做什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite sea animal to see at the aquarium? Why do you like it?
writing.zh: 在水族馆你最喜欢看什么海洋动物？你为什么喜欢它？

writing.en: If you were the teacher for one day, what fun lesson would you teach your class?
writing.zh: 如果你能当一天老师，你会给全班上一堂什么有趣的课？

writing.en: What is your favorite memory from a past vacation? Who was there with you?
writing.zh: 过去假期里你最美好的回忆是什么？当时谁和你在一起？

writing.en: If you could open a small shop, what cool things would you sell inside?
writing.zh: 如果你能开一家小店，你会卖哪些酷炫的东西？

writing.en: What is your favorite fruit juice or drink? How often do you get to drink it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的果汁或饮料是什么？你多久能喝一次？

writing.en: If your pet could wear clothes, what costume would you dress them in?
writing.zh: 如果你的宠物能穿衣服，你会给他们穿什么服装？

writing.en: What is your favorite thing about camping under the stars? What food would you cook?
writing.zh: 在星空下露营你最喜欢什么？你会做什么食物？

writing.en: If you found a glowing treasure chest, what magical item would be inside?
writing.zh: 如果你发现了一个发光的宝箱，里面会有什么神奇的物品？

writing.en: What is your favorite board game or card game? Why is it fun to win?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的桌游或纸牌游戏是什么？为什么赢了很有趣？

writing.en: If you could build a giant snow castle in winter, who would help you build it?
writing.zh: 如果你能在冬天建一座巨型雪城堡，谁会帮你建造？

writing.en: What is your favorite song to listen to when you are happy? Why do you like the music?
writing.zh: 当你高兴的时候你最喜欢听什么歌？你为什么喜欢这音乐？

writing.en: If you could shrink down to the size of an ant, what places would you explore?
writing.zh: 如果你能缩到蚂蚁那么大，你会探索什么地方？

writing.en: What is your favorite season of the year? What do you love doing during that season?
writing.zh: 一年中你最喜欢的季节是什么？你在那个季节最喜欢做什么？

writing.en: If you had a magic pencil that brought drawings to life, what would you draw first?
writing.zh: 如果你有一支能让画作变活的神奇铅笔，你会先画什么？

writing.en: What is your favorite subject at school? What new things did you learn recently?
writing.zh: 学校里你最喜欢的科目是什么？你最近学到了什么新知识？

writing.en: If you could build your own bicycle, what color and cool features would it have?
writing.zh: 如果你能组装自己的自行车，它会有什么颜色和酷炫的功能？

writing.en: What is your favorite memory with your grandparents? What did you do together?
writing.zh: 你和祖父母之间最美好的回忆是什么？你们一起做了什么？

writing.en: If you could visit a zoo at night, which animals would you want to watch?
writing.zh: 如果你能在晚上游览动物园，你想观察哪些动物？

writing.en: What is your favorite kind of pizza topping? Why is it the tastiest?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的披萨馅料是什么？为什么它最美味？

writing.en: If you had a pet monkey for a day, what funny tricks would you teach it?
writing.zh: 如果你能当一天的宠物猴子的主人，你会教它什么有趣的本领？

writing.en: What is your favorite craft activity? What materials do you use to make it?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的手工活动是什么？你用什么材料制作它？

writing.en: If you could fly in a hot air balloon, where would you drift in the sky?
writing.zh: 如果你能乘坐热气球飞行，你会飘去天空中的什么地方？

writing.en: What is your favorite kind of weather? What do you like to do outside?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢什么天气？在户外你喜欢做什么？

writing.en: If you could design a new flavor of ice cream, what ingredients would you put in?
writing.zh: 如果你能设计一款新口味的冰淇淋，你会放入什么配料？

writing.en: What is your favorite storybook hero or heroine? Why do you admire them?
writing.zh: 你最喜欢的童话故事英雄是谁？你为什么钦佩他们？

writing.en: If you could create a new national holiday, what would people celebrate on that day?
writing.zh: 如果你能设立一个新的国家节日，人们在这一天会庆祝什么？

writing.en: What are you most proud of accomplishing this school year? How did you achieve it?
writing.zh: 在这个学年里，你最骄傲完成的事是什么？你是怎么做到的？

Look at the birds in the sky.
My brother plays basketball every Sunday.

speaking.en: Look at the colorful flowers in the garden.

text.en: Mars is the fourth planet from the sun. It looks red because red iron dust covers its rocky ground. Scientists use robot cameras to take clear pictures of its mountains.
text.zh: 火星是离太阳第四近的行星。它看起来是红色的，因为红色铁尘盖着多石的地面。科学家用机器人相机拍它的山的清楚照片。

questions.q: What position is Mars from the sun?
What covers the ground of Mars?
options: Because of iron dust on ground

questions.q: What do scientists use to take pictures?

text.en: Deep-sea fish live in dark water far below the sea surface. Many make soft blue light to find food. Their big eyes help them see in the dark sea.
text.zh: 深海鱼生活在海面下很深的黑水里。很多深海鱼会发出柔和的蓝光找食物。它们的大眼睛帮助它们在黑暗的大海里看东西。

questions.q: Where do deep ocean fish live?
options: In dark waters far below surface

questions.q: What color light do many deep fish make?
What do large eyes help deep-sea fish do?
options: To see in the dark sea

text.en: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity for homes. They work best on warm, sunny days with clear skies. Solar power helps keep the air clean.
text.zh: 太阳能板把阳光变成家里用的电。它们在温暖、晴朗、天空清楚的日子里工作最好。太阳能帮助保持空气干净。

questions.q: What do solar panels turn into electric power?
When do solar panels work best?
What does solar energy do for the air?

text.en: Thousands of worker bees live in one large hive. Each morning, they fly to flowers for sweet nectar. Then they bring the nectar home to make honey.
text.zh: 几千只工蜂住在一个大蜂巢里。每天早上，它们飞到花上采甜花蜜。然后，它们把花蜜带回家做蜂蜜。

questions.q: Where do worker bees live together?
What do worker bees collect from flowers?
What do bees make with the nectar?

text.en: Tall wind turbines stand on open hills with strong wind. Their large white blades turn as the wind moves past. The turning blades help make clean electricity for towns.
text.zh: 高高的风力发电机立在风很大的空旷山上。风吹过时，它们的大白叶片转动。转动的叶片帮助城镇发出清洁的电。

questions.q: Where do wind turbines stand?
What color are the turbine blades?
What do wind turbines create for towns?

text.en: People in ancient Egypt built pyramids with heavy stone blocks. Thousands of workers moved the giant stones over dry sand. Today, people from many countries visit these old buildings.
text.zh: 古埃及人用重石块建造金字塔。几千名工人把大石头搬过干沙地。今天，很多国家的人来参观这些古老建筑。

questions.q: What were ancient pyramids built with?
Where were the giant stones moved across?
What do visitors come to see?

text.en: The rainforest canopy is the top layer of tall tree branches. Colorful parrots and monkeys live high in the leaves. They find sweet fruit and fresh water in the trees.
text.zh: 雨林树冠是高树枝的顶层。彩色鹦鹉和猴子住在高高的树叶里。它们在树上找甜水果和干净的水。

questions.q: What forms the rainforest canopy?
What animals spend their lives up in the canopy?
What food do animals find in the high trees?

text.en: The Great Wall of China is a famous building from long ago. It goes over high mountains and wide valleys for thousands of miles. Ancient soldiers built watchtowers on it to protect their country.
text.zh: 中国长城是很久以前建造的著名建筑。它越过高山和宽阔山谷，延伸几千英里。古代士兵在上面修烽火台保护国家。

questions.q: What is the Great Wall of China?
Where does the Great Wall stretch?
What do ancient soldiers use watchtowers to do?

text.en: Paper was first made in ancient China with tree bark and water. Workers mashed the materials into wet pulp and pressed it into thin sheets. Today, machines make paper quickly so people can write and learn.
text.zh: 纸最早在中国古代用树皮和水做成。工人把材料捣成湿纸浆，再压成薄纸。今天，机器很快造出纸，让人们写字和学习。

questions.q: Where was paper first invented?
What did workers mash materials into?
What do modern machines make?
options: So people can write and learn

text.en: Electric bicycles have small batteries that run a quiet motor. Riders can pedal up steep hills without getting too tired. They are a clean way to travel around cities.
text.zh: 电动自行车有小电池，带动安静的马达。骑车人爬陡坡时踩踏板，不会太累。它们是城市里干净的出行方法。

questions.q: What runs the motor on an electric bike?
What do electric bikes help riders do on steep hills?
options: Allow pedaling easily without getting tired

questions.q: What do electric bicycles help keep clean?

text.en: Coral reefs are colorful homes in the sea made by tiny living animals. Many bright fish find food and safe places among the coral. Clean sea water helps keep these ocean homes safe.
text.zh: 珊瑚礁是小动物在海里做成的彩色家园。很多彩色鱼在珊瑚中找食物和安全的地方。干净的海水帮助保护这些海洋家园。

questions.q: What builds colorful coral reefs?
What finds shelter among coral branches?
What can people do to protect coral reefs?

text.en: Astronauts ride rockets to space to do science work. They live in a space station that goes around Earth. From the window, they see our blue planet in black space.
text.zh: 宇航员坐火箭去太空做科学工作。他们住在绕着地球转的空间站里。从窗户看出去，他们看见黑色太空里的蓝色地球。

questions.q: What do astronauts ride to space?
Where do astronauts live while in space?
What does Earth look like from space?
options: Bright blue planet in black space

text.en: The first trains used steam engines that burned coal to heat water. Today, many fast trains use electricity and run quietly. They carry people and heavy goods between cities.
text.zh: 最早的火车用烧煤加热水的蒸汽机。今天，很多快速火车用电，安静地行驶。它们在城市之间运送人和重货物。

questions.q: What powered the first trains?
What do modern trains use to run?
What do modern trains carry between cities?

text.en: Dolphins are sea animals that use whistles and clicks under water. They swim together in groups to catch small fish. Sometimes they jump high from the blue water.
text.zh: 海豚是用口哨声和咔哒声在水下交流的海洋动物。它们成群游泳，抓小鱼。有时它们从蓝色水里高高跳起。

questions.q: What do dolphins use to communicate underwater?
What is a group of dolphins called?
What do dolphins do to show their speed?

text.en: Wind starts when the sun heats parts of Earth in different ways. Warm air goes up, and cooler air moves in. We can use this moving air to make clean power for cities.
text.zh: 太阳用不同方式晒热地球各处时，风就产生了。热空气上升，凉空气移动过来。我们能用这种流动的空气给城市发清洁的电。

questions.q: What creates wind on Earth?
What happens when warm air rises?
options: Cooler air moves in to take its place

questions.q: What can moving air make for cities?

text.en: Giant sequoias are some of the biggest and oldest trees on Earth. Their thick red-brown bark keeps small insects and fire from hurting them. Some have grown in California for thousands of years.
text.zh: 巨杉是地球上最大、最老的一些树。厚厚的红棕树皮保护它们，不让小虫和火伤害它们。有些巨杉在美国加州生长了几千年。

questions.q: What are giant sequoia trees like?
What protects sequoia trees from fires?
Where have some ancient sequoias grown for thousands of years?

text.en: Suspension bridges use strong steel cables to hold heavy roads over rivers. The cables go between tall towers fixed in the ground. Engineers make the bridges move safely in strong wind.
text.zh: 悬索桥用结实的钢缆把重的道路撑在河上。钢缆连在固定在地上的高塔之间。工程师让桥在大风中能安全地晃动。

questions.q: What supports heavy roads on suspension bridges?
Where are the tall bridge towers anchored?
What do engineers make bridges do in strong wind?
options: To flex safely during strong winds

text.en: The Arctic fox has thick white fur like winter snow. Its warm fur helps it hide and stay warm in very cold weather. In summer, its fur turns brown like rocks and dirt.
text.zh: 北极狐有像冬雪一样厚的白毛。暖和的毛帮助它躲起来，也让它在很冷的天气里保持温暖。夏天，它的毛变成像石头和泥土一样的棕色。

questions.q: What color is the Arctic fox's fur in winter?
What does thick white fur do for the fox?
options: Hides from danger and stays warm

questions.q: What color does its fur turn in summer?

text.en: Thomas Edison made a long-lasting electric light bulb in 1879. Before that, people used candles and oil lamps at night. Today, electric bulbs light homes, schools, and streets around the world.
text.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生在1879年做出耐用的电灯泡。在那以前，人们夜里用蜡烛和油灯。今天，电灯泡照亮世界各地的家、学校和街道。

questions.q: Who invented a long-lasting electric light bulb?
What did people use before the light bulb was invented?
When was the light bulb invented?

text.en: Water dams use flowing river water to make clean electricity. Water rushes through big pipes and turns heavy wheels. This power gives electricity to many nearby homes without burning coal.
text.zh: 水坝用流动的河水发清洁的电。水冲过大管子，带动重轮子转。这种电给附近很多家供电，不需要烧煤。

questions.q: What do hydroelectric dams use to create electricity?
What turns heavy turbine wheels inside the dam?
What is an advantage of hydroelectric energy?

text.en: Camels are strong animals that live in hot, dry deserts. They keep fat in their humps for energy when food is hard to find. Their wide, soft feet help them walk on sand without sinking.
text.zh: 骆驼是生活在炎热干燥沙漠里的强壮动物。食物难找时，它们把脂肪存进驼峰当能量。它们宽而软的脚帮助它们走在沙上不下陷。

questions.q: Where do camels live?
What do camels store in their back humps?
What do wide padded feet do for camels?
options: Help them walk on sand without sinking

text.en: The Great Barrier Reef is a very large coral reef near Australia. It is so big and colorful that people can see it from space. Keeping it safe helps many kinds of sea animals live there.
text.zh: 大堡礁是澳大利亚附近非常大的珊瑚礁。它又大又彩色，人们从太空也能看见它。保护它能帮助很多种海洋动物在那里生活。

questions.q: Where is the Great Barrier Reef located?
What makes the reef easy to see from space?
What does protecting the reef help do?

text.en: Telescopes help people look far into space and find new stars. Glass lenses and mirrors make dim things look bright and clear. Space telescopes, such as Hubble, take pictures of faraway galaxies.
text.zh: 望远镜帮助人们看很远的太空，找到新星星。玻璃镜片和镜子让暗暗的东西看起来亮又清楚。哈勃等太空望远镜拍远处星系的照片。

questions.q: What do telescopes help people see?
What do telescopes use to make dim objects look clear?
What famous space telescope takes photos of galaxies?

text.en: When a worker bee finds flowers, it flies back to the hive. It does a figure-eight dance to show other bees the way. This helps the bees find food quickly.
text.zh: 工蜂找到花后，飞回蜂巢。它跳一个8字舞，告诉别的蜜蜂方向。这帮助蜜蜂很快找到食物。

questions.q: What does a worker bee do after finding fresh flowers?
options: Returns to hive to share news

questions.q: What shape is the waggle dance?
What does the dance do for the colony?
options: Find food quickly without getting lost

text.en: Monarch butterflies fly from Canada to Mexico every autumn. They travel in large orange groups to get away from the very cold north. After resting in warm mountain forests, they fly north again in spring.
text.zh: 帝王蝶每年秋天从加拿大飞到墨西哥。它们成大群橙色蝴蝶飞走，躲开北方的严寒。它们在温暖山林休息后，春天又飞回北方。

questions.q: Where do monarch butterflies travel every autumn?
Where do monarch butterflies fly in autumn?
options: Get away from the cold north

questions.q: When do they fly back north?

text.en: Alexander Graham Bell made the first useful telephone in 1876. He found a way to change a human voice into electric signals on copper wires. His first telephone words were for his helper, Thomas Watson. This new invention let people talk from far away.
text.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔在1876年做出第一部好用的电话。他找到方法，把人的声音变成在铜线上走的电信号。他第一次打电话是对助手托马斯·沃森说话。这项新发明让远处的人能说话。

questions.q: Who invented the first practical telephone?
When was the telephone invented?
What does the telephone change a voice into?
options: Converted voice into electrical signals across wires

questions.q: Who was Bell's assistant that heard his first words?

text.en: Wind is clean energy that will not run out. Big wind turbines stand on open, windy land to catch moving air. Wind turns their large white blades, and machines inside make electricity. This power gives many homes electricity without making dirty smoke.
text.zh: 风是一种用不完的清洁能源。大风力发电机立在有风的空旷地方，接住流动的空气。风吹动大白叶片，里面的机器发电。这种电给很多家供电，不会冒脏烟。

questions.q: What kind of energy is wind?
Where are giant wind turbines placed?
What generates electric power inside wind turbines?
What environmental advantage does wind energy provide?
options: Powers homes without releasing carbon smoke

text.en: Coral reefs are sea homes made by tiny coral animals. They cover less than one percent of the sea floor but are home to one in four sea animals. Bright coral gives fish, turtles, and crabs food and safe places. Keeping dirty things out of the sea helps keep coral reefs safe.
text.zh: 珊瑚礁是小珊瑚动物做成的海洋家园。它们不到海底的百分之一，却养活每四只海洋动物中的一只。明亮的珊瑚给鱼、海龟和螃蟹食物和安全地方。不让脏东西进海里，能保护珊瑚礁。

questions.q: What builds diverse coral reef ecosystems?
What percentage of marine life do coral reefs support?
What benefits do bright corals offer ocean animals?
What does dirty sea water hurt?

text.en: A volcano is an opening in Earth where hot melted rock comes out. Deep under the ground, heat makes this liquid rock, called magma. When too much pressure builds, magma bursts out as lava. Over time, cool lava makes a steep mountain around the opening.
text.zh: 火山是地球上热熔岩会出来的开口。地底很深处，热让岩石变成液体，叫岩浆。压力太大时，岩浆冲出来，变成熔岩。时间久了，冷熔岩在开口周围形成陡山。

questions.q: What is a volcano?
options: An opening in Earth's crust where melted rock erupts

questions.q: What is liquid rock beneath Earth's surface called?
What happens when pressure builds up inside a volcano?
options: Magma bursts through top vent as lava

questions.q: What makes a volcanic mountain?
options: From layers of cooled lava around the vent

text.en: Steam trains changed travel long ago. Workers burned coal to heat water in a large tank. The hot steam pushed heavy parts and turned the train wheels. Trains linked faraway towns and carried goods faster.
text.zh: 很久以前，蒸汽火车改变了出行。工人烧煤，在大水箱里加热水。热蒸汽推动重部件，带动火车轮子转。火车连接远处城镇，更快运送货物。

questions.q: When did steam locomotives revolutionize land transport?
What heated water inside the locomotive boiler?
options: Burning heavy coal in a furnace

questions.q: What drove the heavy metal pistons in steam trains?
What impact did steam trains have on towns?
options: Connected towns and made transport fast

text.en: Honeybees live together in busy groups called colonies. Each colony has one queen, many female workers, and male bees. Workers make wax rooms to keep honey and care for baby bees. Their work moving pollen helps people grow food.
text.zh: 蜜蜂住在叫作蜂群的忙碌大家庭里。每个蜂群有一只蜂王、很多雌工蜂和雄蜂。工蜂做蜡房存蜂蜜，也照顾小蜜蜂。它们带花粉的工作帮助人们种食物。

questions.q: What structure defines a honeybee colony?
What does each honeybee group have?
What do worker bees build honeycomb cells out of?
What does bee pollination help people do?

text.en: Photosynthesis is how green plants make food. Leaves take in sunlight and carbon dioxide from the air. Roots pull water and minerals up from the soil. The plant uses them to make sugar for growing and lets out oxygen.
text.zh: 光合作用是绿色植物做食物的方法。叶子吸收阳光和空气里的二氧化碳。根从泥土里吸上水和矿物质。植物用这些做出供生长用的糖，并放出氧气。

questions.q: What is photosynthesis?
options: Natural chemical process plants use to create food

questions.q: What gas do leaves absorb from air during photosynthesis?
What do plant roots pull up from dark soil?
What two products are generated by photosynthesis?

text.en: The deep ocean starts about two hundred meters below the bright sea surface. Sunlight cannot reach there, so it is very dark. Animals there live in freezing water with strong water pressure. Some fish make their own light to find food and a partner.
text.zh: 深海从明亮海面下大约两百米开始。阳光到不了那里，所以那里很黑。那里的动物生活在冰冷、有很强水压的水里。有些鱼自己发光，找食物和伙伴。

questions.q: What is the answer in the passage?
What is the reason?
What is the deep ocean like?
What does the passage say about some deep ocean fish?

text.en: Bi Sheng made movable clay type printing in China in the eleventh century. He carved Chinese characters on small clay blocks and baked them hard. Hundreds of years later, Johannes Gutenberg made a metal printing press in Germany. Printing made books cheaper and helped knowledge travel around the world.
text.zh: 毕昇在11世纪的中国发明了活字泥版印刷。他把汉字刻在小泥块上，再把它们烧硬。几百年后，约翰内斯·古腾堡在德国做了金属印刷机。印刷让书更便宜，也让知识传到世界各地。

questions.q: Who invented movable clay type printing in China?
What did Bi Sheng carve characters on?
What invention did Johannes Gutenberg create in Germany?
What did printing do for books?
options: Made books affordable and spread knowledge

text.en: Giant sequoias are huge trees in the foggy Sierra Nevada mountains. They can live for more than three thousand years and grow as tall as very tall buildings. Their thick bark keeps fire and wood-rotting fungi from hurting them. These old trees also hold much carbon in the forest.
text.zh: 巨杉是生长在雾蒙蒙的内华达山脉里的大树。它们能活三千多年，长得像很高的楼一样高。厚树皮保护它们，不让火和让木头腐烂的真菌伤害它们。这些老树也把很多碳留在森林里。

questions.q: Where do giant sequoias grow?
What age can giant sequoias reach?
What helps protect giant sequoias?
What ecological role do sequoias perform for forests?

text.en: Robot rovers travel over the dry, rocky ground of Mars. Scientists on Earth control the wheeled robots with radio signals. The rovers have clear cameras, laser tools, and drills to check Martian soil. They look for old clues that water once ran on Mars.
text.zh: 机器人探测车在火星干燥、多石的地面上行走。地球上的科学家用无线电信号控制这些有轮子的机器人。探测车有清楚的相机、激光工具和钻头，检查火星泥土。它们寻找火星过去有水流过的线索。

questions.q: What terrain do robotic rovers explore on Mars?
What do scientists use to control rovers from Earth?
What tools do Mars rovers use?
What chemical clues do rovers search for on Mars?
options: Suggest water once flowed on Mars

text.en: Electric cars use batteries instead of gasoline for power. Electric motors turn the wheels quietly and do not make dirty smoke from a tailpipe. Charging places on highways help cars travel far. More electric cars can make city air cleaner and streets quieter.
text.zh: 电动汽车用电池，不用汽油来提供动力。电动马达安静地带动轮子，不从车尾冒脏烟。公路上的充电站帮助汽车走得远。更多电动汽车能让城市空气更干净，街道更安静。

questions.q: What runs an electric car?
What environmental advantage do electric motors offer?
What infrastructure allows long distance electric travel?
What does electric transportation benefit city residents do?
options: Reduces city air pollution and noise

text.en: Hurricanes are huge spinning storms that start over warm ocean water. Warm water makes wet air rise and brings strong wind. A calm place called the eye is in the middle of the storm. Weather workers use satellites to follow storms and warn towns by the sea.
text.zh: 飓风是在温暖海水上形成的巨大旋转风暴。温水让湿空气上升，带来强风。风暴中间有一块平静地方，叫风眼。气象工作人员用卫星跟踪风暴，提醒海边城镇。

questions.q: Where do massive rotating hurricanes form?
What makes wet air rise in a hurricane?
What is the calm central area of a hurricane called?
What do meteorologists use to track hurricane paths to warn towns?

text.en: The Amazon rainforest is the largest tropical forest on Earth. It is in nine countries in South America and makes much of the world's oxygen. Millions of different plants and animals live under its thick tree top. Keeping the Amazon safe helps the world’s air and weather.
text.zh: 亚马孙雨林是地球上最大的热带森林。它在南美洲九个国家，制造世界上很多氧气。几百万种不同的植物和动物住在厚树冠下面。保护亚马孙有助于世界的空气和天气。

questions.q: What is the Amazon rainforest known as?
What number of South American countries does the Amazon span?
Where do millions of plant and animal species thrive?
What does the Amazon help?

text.en: The Hubble Space Telescope went into space around Earth in 1990. High above Earth, it takes very clear pictures of deep space. Hubble helped people learn the age of the universe. Its photos of colorful clouds and galaxies still help scientists.
text.zh: 哈勃太空望远镜在1990年进入绕地球的太空。在地球高处，它拍很深太空的清楚照片。哈勃帮助人们了解宇宙的年龄。它拍的彩色星云和星系照片还在帮助科学家。

questions.q: When was the Hubble Space Telescope launched?
Where does Hubble take pictures from?
What important discovery did Hubble help astronomers make?
What photos taken by Hubble continue to inspire scientists?

text.en: Wind power uses the energy of moving air. The sun heats land and ocean water in different ways, making air pressure different. Air moves from high pressure to low pressure and turns wind-turbine blades. A generator changes this movement into electricity without dirty smoke.
text.zh: 风力发电用流动空气的能量。太阳用不同方式晒热土地和海水，形成不同的气压。空气从高气压处流向低气压处，带动风机叶片转。一台发电机把这种运动变成电，不会冒脏烟。

questions.q: What does wind power use?
What makes air pressure different?
options: The sun heating land and water

questions.q: Where does air move?
options: From high pressure to low pressure
From low pressure to high pressure

questions.q: What does a generator make?
What does wind power not make?

text.en: Ocean tides are the sea rising and falling each day. The moon and the sun pull on the ocean water. High tides happen on shores when the moon is in the right place. Some power stations use this moving water to make electricity.
text.zh: 海潮是海水每天上升和下降。月亮和太阳拉着海水。月亮在合适位置时，海边会有高潮。一些发电站用这种流动的水发电。

questions.q: What do ocean tides do?
What pulls ocean water?
Where do high tides occur on Earth?
options: Coastal shores aligned with moon's position

questions.q: What do tide power stations use?
What is tide movement like?

text.en: Some living things can make light. Fireflies flash their lights on warm summer nights to find a mate. Deep-sea anglerfish use a glowing part to catch food in the dark. Scientists study this cold light to make better medical pictures.
text.zh: 有些活的东西会发光。萤火虫在温暖夏夜闪光，寻找伙伴。深海琵琶鱼用会发光的部分在黑暗中抓食物。科学家研究这种冷光，做更好的医疗图片。

questions.q: What do living things make in dark places?

What do anglerfish use to catch food?

text.en: People dreamed of flying like birds for many years. In 1903, the Wright brothers made the first airplane with a motor. Their plane flew for twelve seconds over the sandy hills of Kitty Hawk. Today, jet planes carry hundreds of people over oceans in hours.
text.zh: 很多年来，人们梦想像鸟一样飞。1903年，莱特兄弟做出第一架有发动机的飞机。他们的飞机在基蒂霍克的沙丘上飞了12秒。今天，喷气式飞机几个小时就能载几百人飞过大洋。

questions.q: What long-held dream did humans pursue in aviation?
Who achieved the first powered aircraft flight in 1903?
What was the time of the Wright brothers' first motorized flight?
Where did the historic first flight take place?

options: Carry hundreds of passengers across oceans in hours

text.en: Rainbows happen when sunlight goes through drops of water in the air. The light bends and splits into many colors inside each drop. It bounces inside the drop and goes back to our eyes. Then we see a colorful arch in the sky after rain.
text.zh: 阳光穿过空气里的水滴时会有彩虹。光在每滴水里弯曲，分成很多颜色。它在水滴里反弹，再回到我们的眼睛。雨后，我们就看见天空中彩色的弧。

questions.q: What optical process causes rainbows in the sky?
options: Sunlight refracting through airborne water droplets

questions.q: What happens when white sunlight enters a raindrop?
options: Bends and splits into spectral colors

questions.q: What role does internal reflection inside the droplet play?
options: Bounces colored rays toward observer's eyes

questions.q: What shape is a rainbow?
When are rainbows visible in nature?

text.en: Antarctica is the coldest, driest, and windiest continent on Earth. Thick ice covers almost all of its land. Even in this hard place, emperor penguins and Weddell seals live near the sea. Countries agree to keep Antarctica for peaceful science work.
text.zh: 南极洲是地球上最冷、最干、风最大的一块大陆。厚冰盖住了几乎所有土地。即使在这样艰难的地方，帝企鹅和威德尔海豹也住在海边。各国同意把南极洲留给和平的科学工作。

questions.q: What is the climate of Antarctica like?
What percentage of Antarctica's land is buried under ice?
What animals thrive along Antarctic coastal margins?

What covers almost the entire Antarctic land surface?

text.en: Our solar system began about 4.6 billion years ago from gas and dust. A huge cloud of gas and dust spun and fell together. Most of it went to the middle and became our sun. The dust left over hit together for a long time and made the planets.
text.zh: 我们的太阳系大约在46亿年前由气体和尘土开始。一个巨大的气体和尘土云旋转着聚到一起。大部分到了中间，变成我们的太阳。剩下的尘土很久以来互相碰撞，形成行星。

questions.q: When did our solar system begin?
What was the solar system made from first?
What did the middle become?
What made the planets?
What happened to the gas and dust cloud?

text.en: Cai Lun made paper in China around the year 105. He mixed mulberry bark, hemp fibers, old fishing nets, and water. He mashed the mix, spread it on bamboo screens, and dried it. This cheap, strong paper helped people keep records and learn to read.
text.zh: 蔡伦在大约公元105年的中国造纸。他把桑树皮、麻纤维、旧渔网和水混在一起。他把混合物捣碎，铺在竹帘上，再晒干。这种便宜又结实的纸帮助人们记事和学读书。

questions.q: Who invented paper making in China during the Han Dynasty?
What raw materials did Cai Lun combine in water?
